# runner-creation

Creates or hardens an unattended runner, the wrapper, pre-flight gate, permission profile, ledger, watchdog, and caps around a headless agent run. Use when asked to "schedule this", "run it every N hours", "make a headless sweep", or "why does the runner waste tokens", or when a runner double-launches, runs idle, dies silently, or invents data. Not for one-off scripts or interactive sessions.

| | |
|---|---|
| Who starts it | You or the agent. You can ask for it by name (`/shipyard-delivery:runner-creation` in Claude Code); the agent also starts it when the request matches the description. |
| Arguments | `[job name] [create \| harden]` |
| Project settings | `.claude/shipyard/plans/<branch>.md`, `.claude/shipyard/runner-creation.md` |
